tasks.description: Implement read-only Graph Analyst agent that accepts exported graph snapshot JSON files and produces analysis reports.

Define and implement the core detection rules: contradiction cluster detection, connectivity anomaly detection, declared-vs-enforced mismatch detection, drift-over-time detection, and coverage gap detection.

Create output formatter producing JSON reports with fields: finding_id, source_snapshot_id, source_repo_or_filter, detection_rule, observation, evidence_paths, confidence, recommended_owner, recommended_next_action, status, authority_warning.

notes: All tasks are read-only, no lane message dispatch, and must be confined to the Graph Analyst lane.
